A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a 5 mm communication range at 61 GHz.
the 5 mm communication range is achieved by using 22nm FD-SOI technology, 1.5 V AFE, a 0.5 V baseband circuitry and 150um substrate thinning.
we have demonstrated the feasibility of mm wave RFID tags, that can be integrated with a system on chip.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mm wave range is achievable with the state-of-the-art technology, and it opens the door to a new generation of applications.
the mm wave RFID tag is feasible in 22nm SOI CMOS technology.
it is possible to build a 5 mm Range 60 GHz System on Chip RFID Tag in a commercial 22 nm SOICMOS process, with a reasonable power budget.
